F-SV Stable: Seasonal & white
[/b][/size]
I made this for me and a friend, but than I decided to publish it. Here you find 4 stable, one for every season.

[b][color=#ff0000]You need of course the Seasonal Immersion mod. You find it here:[/color] [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-seasonal-immersion.125683/]Entoarox Seasonal Immersion
[/url][/b]

This is a combination of different mods, with a few little changes from myself. And a lot of help from [b]Acerbicon[/b] and [b]Pathoschild[/b]. [u]Ria[/u] was so kind and test it, thanks! Here you find my resources:

- For this wonderful [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891/?]Seasonal Victorian houses  [/url]I have done my stables (you can use them with every house mod, of course). I use Eemie's Victorian houses together with this stables and my tractor house. Thanks a lot to [b]Eemiestardew[/b] for her permission. Please enjoy her great mods:  [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615/?tb=mods&pUp=1]Eemie's stunning mod collection
[/url]
- Here I found the white garage: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/barfys-fancy-farmhouses-and-other-addons-update-links-are-back-up.112984/]barfy's Fancy Farmhouses [/url]There is a lot of great stuff there, take a look.

- [b]Acerbicon[/b], my friend: Without you I would be lost. Can't thank you often enough. I'm in love with all of your mods: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38816245/?tb=mods&pUp=1]Ace's mods - take a look![/url].

- And: Pathoschild, our "modding goodness" and a  friendly & patient person. He "made all possible". Thanks :) Visit all of his [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317/?tb=mods&pUp=1]great mods & updates [/url].

- You should also take a look here: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/forums/stardew-valley.72/]Best Stardew Valley forum![/url][url=http://https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-seasonal-immersion.125683/]
[/url]
- The beautiful horse in the picture is from this mod: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1421/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D1421&pUp=1]Must see - horses from SerialDollface!
[/url]

[b][color=#ffff00]Update 30.09.2017 (Version 1.1):[/color][/b]
- It could be that there have been an error at the Winter stable. Around the roof there is still a "white space", it's an texture error. I have replaced the winter stable with a correct file now. Sorry.
- Added optional file: Stable winter with a heating. Just overwrite the old stable winter with it, if you wish.


[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

- First you install [i]SMAPI[/i] and of course the great  [i]Seasonal Immersion[/i].
- Unzip my file and take the ziped "ContentPack" out, please.

- Than: Go to the place where you have installed all the mods and look for the [i]Seasonal Immersion[/i] mod. Just put my [b][u][color=#ff0000]ZIPED[/color][/u][/b] file "[b]ContentPack[/b]" into the [i]Seasonal Immersion[/i] folder. [u]Please don't unzip it.[/u] Done :)

- If you have a other ziped folder / a other mod in the [i]Seasonal Immersion[/i] mod inside, than you need to overwrite the stable files in this other ziped file / mod with [b]my[/b] files. Just draw them into this ziped (other) mod and "overwrite". But please: Don't forget to make a backup from your original files!
[b]
Why?[/b] Because it is not possible to have two "ContenPack" in the [i]Seasonal Immersion[/i] mod. And the folders inside must always have the name "ContentPack" (and be ziped). So you have to merge a little bit ....

(to uninstall please just delete my ziped folder or overwrite my files with your / the default files)


[b]Greetings and THANKS[/b]
